First, convert 37 weeks and 2 days to days:  
37 weeks × 7 days/week = 259 days  
259 days + 2 days = 261 days before.

Start date: 1628-04-01 (Gregorian, YYYY-MM-DD).  
Subtract 261 days:  
April has 30 days, so back to 1628-03-02 is 30 days (April 1 → March 2).  
Remaining 261 − 30 = 231 days earlier.

Go into 1627:  
1628 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rule after 1582, but century rule: 1600 divisible by 400, so 1628 is leap).  
But we are moving backward from March 1628 into 1627 (non-leap year).  
From 1628-01-01 to 1628-03-02 is 31 (Jan) + 29 (Feb leap) + 2 (Mar) = 62 days.  
So 231 − 62 = 169 days earlier into 1627.

Count back 169 days from 1628-01-01:  
December 1627 has 31 days → 1627-12-01 is 31 days before 1628-01-01.  
169 − 31 = 138 remaining.  
November 30 days → 138 − 30 = 108.  
October 31 days → 108 − 31 = 77.  
September 30 days → 77 − 30 = 47.  
August 31 days → 47 − 31 = 16.  
July 31 days → but 16 < 31, so go into July.

That’s wrong: Actually, July 16 to July 31 is 15 days, plus 1 day to Aug 1 = 16 days difference. So July 16 is 16 days before Aug 1.
